PART VI  Pediatric Specialties
A premature infant with vitamin E deficiency may experi-
ence hemolytic anemia (oxidative destruction of red blood 
cells). However, this anemia is now uncommon today because 
of improvements in human milk fortifiers and infant formula 
composition. The human milk fortifiers and premature infant 
formulas now contain appropriate vitamin E/PUFA ratios for 
preventing hemolytic anemia.
Because the dietary requirement for vitamin E depends on 
the PUFA content of the diet, the recommended intake of vi-
tamin E is expressed commonly as a ratio of vitamin E to
